title: Direct w:ind on cell paragraphs: left/right/firstLine in points, firstLineChars in em of the run size, and a w:bidi paragraph's left indent at the inline start (right edge)
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-28), pymupdf char origins: left 720 + firstLine 360 puts the first glyph 54 pt inside the cell edge and the wrapped line 36 pt; firstLineChars 200 at sz 24 is 24 pt; the w:bidi paragraph with left 720 ends 36 pt inside the right cell edge

cases.note: read-only cells dropped direct indents entirely; editable cells (blockAttrs) always emitted them
character-unit indent scales with the run size: 2 em of 12 pt = 24 pt, not 2 em of the 11 pt default
logical start margin: under w:bidi the left indent sits at the right cell edge
